property_summary: For any bytes4 interfaceId that is not equal to type(IERC165).interfaceId or type(IAccessControl).interfaceId, c.supportsInterface(interfaceId) must return false; the mutant returns true for all interfaceIds, violating this rule for unsupported interfaceIds. Since types are unavailable, we hardcode the known IDs with constants.
change_summary: Return true unconditionally instead of checking interfaceId.
